3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	from itertools import pairwise
6	
7	from mdata import Prices
8	from risk.types import Returns
9	
10	
11	def log_returns(prices: Prices) -> Returns:
12	    """One return per date after the first, per ticker."""
13	    if len(prices.dates) < 2:
14	        raise ValueError("log_returns needs at least two dates")
15	    values = {
16	        ticker: tuple(today / yesterday - 1 for yesterday, today in pairwise(closes))
17	        for ticker, closes in prices.closes.items()
18	    }
19	    return Returns(
20	        base_date=prices.dates[0],
21	        dates=prices.dates[1:],
22	        tickers=prices.tickers,
23	        values=values,
24	    )
